meta.what: Detector and tracker stability on real Arducam frames, paired at 15 fps
meta.revision: fda6df3 (robot/detect.py unchanged; arms replay cached detections through robot.detect.Tracker with overridden constants)
meta.machine: WSL box RTX 3080 (raw detections cached on CPU, ORT 1.31.0, FP32, floor score 0.05 or 0.01 for f01); tracker replay on the Mac

clips.b720: baseline-720p.mjpeg 900 frames @30 fps -> 450 frames @15 fps, sha256 20f2f8a3...e9c81

meta.ground_truth: persistent objects from IoU clustering of all arms' detections, checked by eye on frame 0 (gt-*.json in build/detect-quality/detector); live uses 3 shelf bottles; held items use pooled best box with label from bench.focus_clip.HELD (a proxy: exists only where some model sees the item)
meta.display_rule: a frame counts as matched when a confirmed in-view track overlaps the object at IoU 0.5 and its current detection scores at least GATE (default DETECT_LOW 0.10, as robot/focus.py requires); visible = matched within the last 3 frames (D159 200 ms bridge)
commands: python export.py yoloe-26{s,m}-seg.pt H W   (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= ; build/detect-quality/detector/export.py; recipe of research/detector.md)
python -m bench.detect_stability run MODEL H W CLIP OUT.jsonl SOURCE_FPS [PRE]   (CPU)
python -m bench.detect_stability sweep SPEC.json OUT.json   (spec: build/detect-quality/detector/mkspec.py)
flock gpu.lock python -m bench.detect_stability time MODEL H W CLIP

gpu_ms_3080_ort_cuda_fp32.note: host-bound under WSL (every model within 30%); not a cost ratio. No Jetson engines built: no model arm won.

jetson_cpu_cost_tdn.640x360: 3.14 ms p50 (6 threads, camera_settings worker running; cv2 absdiff, gray, blur 5x5, addWeighted, where)

meta.not_run: arm 5 constant-velocity matching (live ID switches are duplicate tracks and box growth to the hand, not motion); Jetson engines; new camera clips (none arrived); held-out clip
